title: 第1621章 矿洞设定
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

剑不凡眼睛瞪的像铜铃：【老大，这么狠？】

【共享。】

【是是是。。共享，给。】

阿四的世界观里，没有人会违背神的旨意。

他虽然不聪明，但是他相信神啊，共享后他们不能接，哪怕要做，也只能通过他。

由于他们没有组队。

阿四贼眉鼠眼，看了一圈周围，在确定没人后，发送到附近频道。

林风和剑不凡两人终于看到他任务的全貌。

前面确实是介绍冤魂矿洞。

而且还有一些细节，比如从入口掉下来的，全都会化作冤魂攻击玩家。

冤魂矿洞很大很大，可能大到让所有人都无法相信。

按照背景推测。

说是地下矿洞，不如说是地下城。

绵延千里，好多城市的地下都有，入口也有好几个，只是这个入口发现的最早。

一句话，冤魂矿洞是渡硬国这个阶段，最大最强的副本。

里面错综复杂，无数洞窟交错，BOSS数量众多。

而且进入全都是随机的，并且没有地图，地图界面只能看到很小范围，走过之后，其他地方依旧会陷入黑暗。

【我去~~这张图。。不就是纯为难人吗？】

阿四是幸运儿，他接到任务是前往阿多矿洞最深处，找到BOSS，并和BOSS交易，解除内心的恶魔。

看完任务内容。

林风和剑不凡都满脸震惊的看着阿四。

【我去，你是恶魔啊？】

【看不出来啊，你们渡硬国人，不是很相信神的吗？】

阿四尴尬的说道：【这里只是游戏，我现在被封印，不能提升实力，渡硬国神选会马上开始，我一定要解除封印。】

他可能觉得自己暴露太多了，连忙住嘴。

【噢？看来还有故事啊。】林风似笑非笑：【说说看呗。】

剑不凡：【就是，都到这地步了，说呗，你给的资料越多，我们越能帮你！】

【呼！】阿四深吸一口气：【好，我相信你们。】

阿四的职业很特殊。

按照渡硬国的设定，魔鬼在他们国家是最不容存在的。

所以，他也是稀里糊涂。

【你们是大夏的人，我才告诉你们的，如果是渡硬国玩家，我不可能告诉你们。】

【那什么神选会又是什么？】

【老大，这我知道，算是渡硬国官方最大的比赛，可以出名。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Jian Bufan's eyes were as wide as copper bells: [Boss, are you so cruel?】

【Share.】

【Yes yes yes..Share, give.】

In Ah Si’s worldview, no one would violate God’s will.

Although he is not smart, he believes in God. After sharing, they cannot accept it. Even if they want to do it, they can only go through him.

Because they are not in a team.

The fourth thief looked around with a stern look, and after confirming that no one was around, he sent the message to a nearby channel.

Lin Feng and Jian Bufan finally saw the full extent of his mission.

The front is indeed an introduction to the Wrongful Soul Mine.

And there are some details, such as everything that falls from the entrance will turn into ghosts and attack the player.

The Wounded Soul Mine is very big, perhaps so big that no one can believe it.

Guess based on the background.

It is better to say it is an underground mine than an underground city.

It stretches for thousands of miles and is found underground in many cities. There are also several entrances, but this entrance is the earliest one discovered.

In a word, the Wounded Soul Mine is the largest and most powerful dungeon at this stage of Crossing Hard Country.

It's intricate inside, with countless intersecting caves and numerous bosses.

Moreover, entry is all random, and there is no map. Only a small area can be seen on the map interface. After walking through, other places will still fall into darkness.

[I’ll go~~this picture..Isn't it just to make things difficult?】

Ah Si is the lucky one. He received the mission to go to the deepest part of the Addo Mine, find the BOSS, and make a deal with the BOSS to relieve the demon in his heart.

Read the mission content.

Lin Feng and Jian Bufan both looked at Ah Si with shock on their faces.

[Go ahead, are you a devil?】

[Can’t you see it? Don’t you people from Dujiang believe in God very much?】

Ah Si said awkwardly: [This is just a game. I am sealed now and cannot improve my strength. The God of Crossing Kingdom will begin soon. I must lift the seal.】

He probably felt that he had exposed himself too much and quickly shut up.

【oh?It seems there is a story.] Lin Feng seemed to be smiling but not smiling: [Tell me about it.】

Jian Bufan: [That’s it, it’s come to this. Let’s just say, the more information you give us, the more we can help you!】

【Phew!Ah Si took a deep breath: [Okay, I believe you.】

Ah Si’s profession is very special.

According to the setting of Du Hard Country, devils are the least allowed to exist in their country.

Therefore, he was also confused.

[You are from Daxia, so I am telling you. If you are a player from the Hard Country, I would not be able to tell you.】

[Then what is the Chosen Council?】

[Boss, I know this. It is the official biggest competition in Du Hard Country, and it can make you famous.】
